content: Paulo kanguajambuha aghanja bhake
Nungupala kummanyiha kwa mwenga nhacha ghwetu Foibe, ntendalihengo mu ngwemuko ya Kenikilea.

Nunguayupa muntekule kiyaha ywombe kanhyubhalila Kilisito handa twenga, muntekule handa payibhanogha bhandu bha Chapanga na kunpegha utangwo ghohele ghwakaghupala kuhuma kwa mwenga, kiyaha ywombe kabhatangatila bhandu atangalo, na kwa nenga bhubho.
Munnjambuhe Pilisika na nngwana ghwake Akula, atendalihengo ayangu mu Kilisito Yesu,
bhombe akibhegha kala kuhwegha kwa kya nenga ngati bhanopohe. Bhangunoghwa kulumbwa, chepa kuhuma kwa nenga ghweka, ngati kuhuma mu ngwemuko hyoha hya bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi.

Bhubho mubhajambuhe bhandu bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito bhaakunganika mu lubhagha lwabhe. Kangi munnjambuhe na ghanja ghwangu npalo Epaineto, ywakabheghite mundu ghwa kandahi kuhyunbhalila Kilisito akwo ku nkoa Asia.
Mnnjambuhe Malia, ywakatendite lihengo kya ukangamalo kwa kya mwenga.
Mubhajambuhe Andiloniko na Yunia, Akaayahudi ayangu bhaabheghite mu kibhopo papamu na nenga. Bhene ndo bhangumanyikwa muno na andumila, nabho bhakibhegha mu Kilisito kukali ya nenga.
Munnjambuhe na Ampiliato ghanja ghwangu npalo kiyaha kalilunga na Bambo.
Munnjambuhe na Ulibano, ntenda lihengo nnyetu mu Kilisito, papamu na nnghanja ghwangu npalo Sitakisi.
Munnjambuhe na Apele ywakang'ehitwe na kughuyimiha uhyubhalilo ghwake mu Kilisito. Mubhajambuhe na bhoha bhaabheghite mu lubhagha lwa Alisitobulo
Mnnjambuhe nnongo ghwangu Helodioni Nnyahudi nnyangu. Na mubhajambuhe bhoha bha mulubhagha lwa Nalikisi bhaannyubhalila Bambo.
Mubhaambuhe Tilifaina na Tilifosa bhala adala bhaatenda lihengo kya ukangamalo mu Bambo. Munnjambuhe nng'anja ghwangu npalo Pelisisi, nndala yungi ywakatendite lihengo kya ukangamalo mu Bambo.
Kangi munnjambuhe Lufo, nhaghulwa mu Bambo, papamu na ma ghwake ywakabheghite handa mama ghwangu bhubho,
bhubho nungutaghila lilobhe kwa Asinikilito, na Filegoni, na Helime, na Patiloba, na Helima na alongo bhoha bhaanhyubhalilite Kilisito bhaabheghite papamu na bhombe.
Bhubho munnjambuhe Filologo, na Yulia na Nelea na nhacha ghwake, na Olomupa, na bhandu bhoha bhaanhyubhalilite Kilisito bhaabheghite papamu nabho.
Bhubho mulijambuhe mabhene kwa mabhene kwa naho ya upalo. Bhandu bhoha bhaanhyubhalilite Kilisito bhaabheghite kunu bhanguajambuha.
Mahigho gha kuyomolela
Maalongo bhangu, nunguasigha mulindakile na kuahyepetuka bhoha bhaabhayambuha kubhaghulana na kubhika himbingiko ya kya mahundo ghamulihundite.

Kiyaha bhandu handa abho anguntendela ng'obhe lihengo Bambo ghwetu Kilisito, ngati bhangutende lihengo kwa lumatamata lwabhe bhene, bhandu abho bhangubhakuluha kwa malagho ghabhe gha kupembehela, na kuyipotoha miyoyo ya bhandu bha maha.
Bhandu bhoha ayihwa ya kya uyitikilo ghwenu, na nenga memwa na uyelelo kwa kya mwenga. Peni nungupala mwenga mmeghe na mahala mu milando ya maha na kya nga uhokelo mu milando mihakata.
Chapanga yuanakuyegha uhihimilo katampochola nchipila, na kubhapegha mwenga makakala gha kunhotola. Umaha ghwa Bambo ghwetu Yesu ghubheghe na mwenga.
Timoteo ntenda lihengo nnyangu kanguajambuha. Ubhwabhu abhu Lukio, na Yasoni na Sosipateli, Akaayahudi ayangu bhanguajambua.
Na nenga Telitio, nilityeka lihamba ali handa Paulo pakang'ombilite, nunguajambuha mu lihina lya Bambo.
Gayo, nkolannima ghwangu na ghwa bhandu bhaakwemukila kwa ywombe kanguajambuha, na Elasito mmika ngalabha ghwa kitami aki, papamu na Kwalito nnongo ghwetu kanguajambuha bhubho.
Nungubhayupila kukita umaha ghwa Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisito ghubheghe papamu na mwenga mabhoha. Ayi mwika.
Mayupo gha kuyomolela
Hino, tuntike Chapanga kiyaha ywombe ndo nkulu, katutenda twenga tubheghe nauhyubhalilo na ghunakuyeghwa na Yesu Kilisito, yene yinubhalandamihite mwenga. Makachu Mihalo ayi ya Maha yikihihwa.

Peni mbwepo aywo yikihwimwulighwa na kumanyikwa kwa kukindila matyeko ya ambuye kubhukana na malaghilo gha Chapanga ghwa manjubha ghoha, ngati bhandu bha milima yoha bhamokole kunhyubhalila na kunnyitikila.
Ukulu ndo ghwa Chapanga ywa kighweka, yuna mahala, ywene kwa njila ya Yesu Kilisito mbaka manjubha ghoha! Ayi mwika.
